articles.title: Seiko Epson (TSE:6724) Issues ¥20 Billion Green Bond
articles.summary: Seiko Epson (TSE:6724) has issued a new ¥20b unsecured green bond to fund projects aligned with its environmental goals. The climate bond structure links the funding to specific sustainability uses, such as energy efficiency and lower impact production facilities. The issuance adds to the growing pool of ESG-focused financing options available to Japanese industrial issuers.
